For q=a0+a1*z+a2*z^2, A=a0+a1/3+a2/5, B=2*a1/3+4*a2/7, C=8*a2/35. A+eps*(abs(A)+abs(B)+abs(C))<0 certifies infeasibility even under unchanged norm/P2/P4 gates.
Additional q=z*(Z-z) gives necessary Z>=3/5 at the exact isotropic target. It is only a necessary criterion, not a replacement for full facets.
The first actual infeasible index is an output, not predetermined. A birth13 obstruction is a hypothesis before the exact readback runs.
